narrative: The June 6 order tasks Treasury, NSA, and CISA to stand up an AI Cybersecurity Clearinghouse coordinating vuln scanning and patch distribution across federal and critical-infrastructure operators, and the NSA Model Context Protocol information sheet already supplies a cross-sector technical advisory for an AI-tooling flaw class. Together they are early scaffolding for the predicted joint guidance.
remaining_gap: Neither is yet a multi-authority embedded-CVE document; no CISA/FDA/NHTSA/ENISA joint advisory or MoU naming AI-found CVEs has been published.
